entities.summary: Eliot Laurence Spitzer is an American politician and attorney who served as the 54th governor of New York from 2007 to 2008, when he resigned because of his involvement in a prostitution scandal. A member of the Democratic Party, he was also the 63rd attorney general of New York from 1999 to 2006.
